crossRefs.note: He made a border of a hand’s width around it, and made a golden molding on its border around it.

translations.web: He made a border of a hand’s width around it, and made a golden molding on its border around it.
translations.bsb: And he made a rim around it a handbreadth wide and put a gold molding on the rim.
translations.kjv: Also he made thereunto a border of an handbreadth round about; and made a crown of gold for the border thereof round about.
translations.asv: And he made unto it a border of a handbreadth round about, and made a golden crown to the border thereof round about.
